claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord + SpeciesTraitMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no 'species_trait' kind. The taxonomy defines species_trait_root as a source atom, but types.ts never defines SpeciesTraitRecord or a corresponding mechanics family. No honest encoding is possible without this record kind.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Draconic Flight is a species trait of Dragonborn, not a class feature, spell, or mastery. 'When you reach character level 5, you can channel draconic magic to give yourself temporary flight.'

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_fly_speed effect in SpeciesTraitEffect (or ClassFeatureEffect)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect grants 'a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.' The v4 taxonomy lists modify_speed as an atom, but ClassFeatureEffect (and any species-trait equivalent) does not include it. A new effect variant encoding fly speed — equal to or independent of walk speed — is required.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: During that time, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: condition_triggered_expiry in Duration or lifecycle atoms
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The duration ends on three conditions: (1) 10-minute timer, (2) voluntary retraction (no action), (3) the Incapacitated condition. The existing Duration type covers 'timed' for (1) but has no shape for condition-triggered expiry. The lifecycle atom 'expire' handles timed expiry only; no 'break on condition' variant exists.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: ...that last for 10 minutes or until you retract the wings (no action required) or have the Incapacitated condition.
